purpose: Super Admin creates a new hostel master record
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/hostels with code H_UC1, name UC Hostel 1, capacity 120
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with new hostel record

purpose: Super Admin activates or deactivates hostel record
preconditions: Target hostel exists; Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and is_active set to False

purpose: Super Admin manages Warden role binding for a hostel
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and Warden role binding active

purpose: Super Admin manages Caretaker role binding with shift context
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and Caretaker role binding recorded

purpose: Student submits hostel accommodation request
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with status submitted

purpose: Super Admin records batch room allotment decision
preconditions: Accommodation request submitted; room has capacity
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, allotment status active, room occupancy incremented

purpose: Super Admin records formal room vacation update
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, allotment status vacated, room occupancy decremented

purpose: Student views own room allocation information
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK containing only caller student allotment information

purpose: Caretaker maintains room availability and status
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and room status updated

purpose: Caretaker records individual room exchange between two students
preconditions: Two students hold active allotments in the same assigned hostel
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and rooms swapped with exchange history retained

purpose: Warden reviews room assignments and occupancy patterns
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with allotments list for assigned hostel

purpose: Caretaker records student attendance batch
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/attendance with date and attendance entries
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and attendance entries stored

purpose: Student views own attendance records
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with only caller student attendance records

purpose: Student submits leave request
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/leaves with dates, leave_type, and reason
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, status submitted, notification sent

purpose: Caretaker reviews and records leave approval decision
preconditions: Leave request submitted; Caretaker has hostel.leave.review
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and leave status updated to approved

purpose: Student views own leave status and history
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning only leaves submitted by the caller

purpose: Student submits hostel-related complaint
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, status submitted

purpose: Caretaker records escalation of complaint to Warden
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status escalated, escalated timestamp recorded

purpose: Warden monitors escalated or unresolved complaints
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with complaints list for assigned hostel

purpose: Student submits guest room booking request
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/guest-rooms with guest details and dates
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, status submitted

purpose: Caretaker reviews and approves guest room booking request
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status approved, room assigned

purpose: Student views own guest room booking status and history
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning only bookings for calling student

purpose: Student submits extended stay request for vacation/break
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, status submitted

purpose: Warden reviews and approves extended stay request with charge info
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, status approved, charge recorded

purpose: System records extended-stay charge and compliance information
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK showing charge_amount=1000 and compliance_status=pending

purpose: Caretaker records disciplinary fine
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/fines with student_user_id, amount, reason, date
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, fine status recorded

purpose: Student views own fine records and history
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning only fines for calling student

purpose: Caretaker maintains hostel operational inventory records
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and item stored

purpose: Caretaker maintains staff duty coordination information
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/staff-logs with staff_name, role, shift, date
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and staff duty log recorded

purpose: Warden maintains security guard shift schedule
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and security guard shift stored

purpose: Caretaker publishes notice for assigned hostel
preconditions: Caretaker has hostel.notice.publish for assigned hostel
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and notice active

purpose: Student views notices on authorized notice board
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK showing notices for student allocated hostel

purpose: Generate predefined operational summary report
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK containing room stats, leave count, and complaint count

purpose: System issues HM notifications for supported events
preconditions: Student has pending or updated notification events
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning notifications for authenticated user

purpose: Warden reviews attendance summaries and trends
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with attendance entries for assigned hostel

purpose: Warden reviews leave information and summaries
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with leave requests for assigned hostel

purpose: Warden reviews fine summaries and disciplinary patterns
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with fine records for assigned hostel

purpose: Warden reviews staff assignments or shift information
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with staff duty logs for assigned hostel
